source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Look at the failed tests.
3. Check the equipment for obvious signs of damage.

### Test Records

> ![Test records](./pics/test_records.png)

Here is an example test report.

The top 4 lines are the PASS/FAIL tests. The bottom line is for the information of the equipment owner and what was done. (What is that other stuff?).

The 5th and last item down (500V insulation test) comes out as 0.0. There is a fail recorded.

### Visual

> ![Test records](./pics/visual.png)


When I looked back at the tester again and closely checked around the plug, the plug is totally cracked apart. This was probably my fault. The plug was opened up to change the fuse to a 2 amp and I should have fitted a new plug, but I was in a rush.
